name: contact
description: Configuration keywords for 'plot item create contact'. Controls contact rendering, force scaling, coloring by properties or attributes, cut planes, and legend display.

sub_items.name: color-by
sub_items.description: Color contacts by force, model properties, or text attributes

sub_items.name: cut
sub_items.description: Clip visualization with a cutting plane

notes: 'radius-factor' and a bare 'automatic'/'automatic off' are NOT contact-item keywords - they fail with 'Unused extra parameter' (verified PFC2D 7.00). Force-chain thickness comes from 'scale-by-force'; the word 'automatic' is only valid inside 'color-options ... minimum automatic maximum automatic'.
The force-chain pattern below is verified working on PFC2D 7.00.

First-slot keywords on PFC3D 9.7: active all-contacts both-directions clip cm-normal color-by color-options cut directed display ghosts legend map orientation range scale-by-force scale-by-magnitude selected-only shape transparency.
contact 'shape' drill-down (live 9.7): arrow cylinder disk joint sphere.

keywords.description: Show item in plot (default when created)
keywords.name: active on

keywords.description: Scale contact line thickness by force magnitude
notes: When on, thicker lines indicate larger forces
keywords.name: scale-by-force

keywords.description: Show color legend for this item
keywords.name: legend active on

keywords.description: Configure color scale for numeric/vector attributes
keywords.syntax: color-options scaled ramp rainbow minimum automatic maximum automatic
notes: Goes with color-by for continuous color mapping; never as the last clause: on PFC 6.0, 7.0 and 9.8 a color-options that ends the command silently drops the color-by and the item falls back to a plain color (follow it with e.g. 'legend active on', or put it before color-by). Verified on PFC3D 6.00.30, 7.00.161 and 9.8.54 (2026-10-29).
keywords.name: color-options

examples.command: plot item create contact active on color-by vector-attribute "force" color-options scaled ramp rainbow minimum automatic maximum automatic scale-by-force on legend active on
examples.description: Force chains with thickness and color encoding magnitude. Use case: Contact force network

examples.command: plot item create contact active on color-by numeric-property "fric" color-options scaled ramp rainbow minimum automatic maximum automatic legend active on
examples.description: Friction coefficient distribution across contacts. Use case: Contacts colored by friction
